_comment: A small evaluation set of repeated cross-device memory tasks.
Each task models the project's core promise: a fact is WRITTEN from one
surface (desktop, phone, claude.ai, cursor) and RECALLED later from a
different one. The eval measures whether search actually surfaces the
right note -- recall@1, recall@5 and MRR -- so a ranking or schema
change that quietly degrades retrieval fails CI instead of shipping.
To grow it: add { query, expected } entries. `expected` is the exact
title of the note that SHOULD rank first for `query`. Keep queries
realistic (what a human/agent would actually search), and keep the
expected note unambiguous. The harness seeds every note fresh, in order,
with no access history, so results are deterministic and reproducible.
